factual_support.0: A material amount, direction, company or financial claim contradicts or lacks source support.
factual_support.1: Stated amounts are supported but one required measure is omitted or ambiguously described.
factual_support.2: All three required measures are correctly grounded; qualitative claims follow from the observations.

period_and_units.0: The answer mixes periods, currencies or units, or labels fiscal data as calendar-year data.
period_and_units.1: The fiscal year and units are correct but actual dates or disclosure scope are incomplete.
period_and_units.2: Company, actual annual dates, currency and unit are explicit and consistent.

interpretation.0: Unsupported causes, forecasts or investment conclusions replace interpretation of the requested observations.
interpretation.1: The answer lists correct values without distinguishing revenue, operating income and net income.
interpretation.2: The answer explains a source-supported relationship among the three measures and distinguishes their meanings.

citation_support.0: Citations are absent, fabricated or attached to unrelated claims.
citation_support.1: Some claims have correct citations but at least one requested measure lacks clear support.
citation_support.2: Every requested measure has a resolvable reference supporting its amount and fiscal context.
